units.source_text: 薰中纳言以为还是夜里，岂知已近破晓。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought it was still night, not realizing that dawn was already near.

units.source_text: 他深恐被人看到，惹起讥议，心中不免烦乱。

en.t: He was deeply afraid of being seen and provoking criticism, and his heart could not help growing troubled.

units.source_text: 这也是为了不欲损伤二女公子名誉。

en.t: This, too, was because he did not wish to damage the Second Princess's reputation.

units.source_text: 他听说二女公子为了怀孕而身体不适，今天看见果然如此。

en.t: He had heard that the Second Princess was unwell because of her pregnancy, and today he saw that it was indeed so.

units.source_text: 为了遮羞而束在身上的那条腰带，薰中纳言看了也觉得可怜，这也是使他不忍放肆的一个原由。

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, saw the sash she had tied around herself to hide her shame, he felt pity for her, and this too was one reason he could not bring himself to act recklessly.

units.source_text: 他想：“回想起来，我是屡次错过良机的。

en.t: He thought, "Looking back, I have missed good opportunities again and again.

units.source_text: 然而丧情灭理之事，毕竟违背我的本意；

en.t: Yet doing something that destroys feeling and violates reason is, after all, against my true intention;

units.source_text: 且凭一时冲动而胡行乱为之后，势必心无宁日。

en.t: and if I act wildly on a moment's impulse, afterward my heart will surely know no peace.

units.source_text: 偷偷摸摸地追求欢会，实甚苦心劳思，又使得女方也平添忧患。”

en.t: To seek secret meetings in furtive ways is truly a torment of the heart and mind, and it only adds new anxieties for the woman as well."

units.source_text: 然而他这种贤明的思想不能扑灭热烈的情火，直到此时他还恋念二女公子，真乃岂有此理。

en.t: Yet these wise thoughts of his could not extinguish the fierce fire of passion, and even now he still longed for the Second Princess, which was truly unreasonable.

units.source_text: 他立志非把二女公子弄到手不可，其用心实甚不良。

en.t: He resolved that he must possess the Second Princess no matter what, and his intentions were truly improper.

units.source_text: 他只觉得二女公子那比以前稍稍消瘦而依旧风流娴雅的面影，片刻不曾离去，一直随附在他身旁，因此其他一切事情全都不在他心上了。

en.t: He felt only that the Second Princess's image, a little thinner than before yet still graceful and refined, had not left him for even a moment but remained constantly at his side, so that nothing else at all stayed in his mind.

units.source_text: 他只是想：“二女公子一心想赴宇治，我可否陪她去呢？

en.t: He thought only, "The Second Princess longs wholeheartedly to go to Uji; could I accompany her there?
I fear Prince Niou would not permit it.

units.source_text: 不过，偷偷地带她去毕竟很不妥便。

en.t: Still, secretly taking her there would after all be highly improper.

units.source_text: 有何办法可以不受世人非难而成遂这个愿望呢？”

en.t: Is there any way to fulfill this wish without drawing the world's condemnation?"

units.source_text: 他回家时已魂不附体，茫然地躺下了。

en.t: By the time he returned home, he was already beside himself, and he lay down in a daze.
